name: water_tank_entropy_change
title: Entropy change of water in an insulated rigid tank (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise for a closed rigid tank with 2 kg of saturated water at 100 kPa, three quarters liquid. The final state is saturated vapour at the same specific volume, and the model computes the entropy change of the water.
